question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Apprehension
solution:
The correct answer is:** 'Fear'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is: **'****Apprehension'.(आशंका)**
 
• The word **'Apprehension'** is a **'Noun'** meaning anxiety or fear that something bad or unpleasant will happen.
 
 
• **Example:** *She felt sick with **apprehension**.*
 
 
 
• The word '**Fear' (डर)** means an unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.
 
 
• **Example**: *He urged his listeners to **fear** God.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Myth'** means a traditional story, especially one concerning the early history of a people or explaining a natural or social phenomenon.(कल्पित कथा)
 
• **'Barbarous'** means extremely brutal.(बर्बर)
 
• **'Courage'** means the ability to do something.(साहस)
